description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) MASTERFUL TACTICS (Tactical Brethren, 1 CP) — WP-M3b (SMCodexB.gd, through the custom:sm11e dispatcher). Fixture sm11e_m3b_reactive (P1 Orks ACTIVE vs P2 Space Marines, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_sm11e_m3b_fixtures.gd). Setup privileges plus: the Kommandos placed ~6" in front of the Hellblasters; the tactical doctrine active for the Space Marines army. The Ork player's Kommandos make a normal move (BEGIN_NORMAL_MOVE + drag + Confirm Move) ending within 8" of the unengaged Hellblaster Squad (TACTICUS INFANTRY); enemy_ended_move opens for the Space Marines player; a real click spends 1 CP; with the tactical doctrine the Hellblasters can make a normal move of up to 6" (no D6); they make it and the Orks get the phase back.

steps.comment: setup privilege: the Space Marines player gets the eight WP-M2b detachments (stratagems reloaded), auto wound allocation, the other player 0 CP (no stratagem windows not under test); the tactical doctrine is active (army combat doctrine state — the selection UI is WP-M2a's)
steps.equals: Terminator Storm Force + Assault Brethren + Gravis Linebreaker Force + Devastator Brethren + Gravis Siege Force + Tactical Brethren + Ironclad Champions + Tacticus Firestorm Force

steps.comment: setup privilege: straight to the phase under test
a window not under test (if any) is declined
the Ork player's own unit_selected_to_move window (if any) declined
the Ork move (drag + Confirm Move): it ends within 8" of the Hellblasters
the Ork player's own unit_ended_normal_move window (not under test) is declined first
REAL click (the Space Marines player) on the stratagem's Use button
tactical doctrine: a normal move of up to 6" (no D6)
P2 makes the move (drag + Confirm Move)
the Orks have the phase back
